scope: All remaining partial/unresolved game-research families outside KH1 and Re:Chain of Memories; preserve completed KH1 decisions and concurrent Re:CoM work. Other limitations are accounted for but not silently recast as research tasks.
decisionRule: For every family, ask whether the missing detail enables progression, collection or achievement completion. Resolve useful ambiguity; defer optional precision only with concrete sufficient guidance, missing detail, rationale and reopen condition. Evidence status and practical research disposition remain distinct.

records.playerGoal: Collect the three remaining upper-Mineshaft crowns and finish Sunset.
records.sufficientGuidance: Each of Sunset 32/36/40 gives the Engine Chamber/Magic Boost/white-orb starting point and complete Glide LV3 pipe sweep to the far landing. All three physical crowns and the solved Sunset board are covered.
records.deferredDetails: Independent binding of each pipe/landing to board slots 32, 36 and 40; not the three-crown route itself.
records.deferralReason: The shared sweep collects the entire small group. Certifying a per-pipe slot would shorten an already localized search, but is not needed to obtain the crowns or finish the board. Existing uncertainty is retained.
records.reopenWhen: A player cannot find a remaining crown with the sweep, or a requested missing-slot-only locator needs exact mapping.

records.playerGoal: Find and buy equipment, including avoiding Dark Anklet missability.
records.sufficientGuidance: All 131 equipment records have acquisition text; named vendor/loot/reward/recipe paths are present. Dark Anklet specifically explains visiting Disney Castle Mogjiro before the Lingering Will portal cutoff and the later Twilight Town/Radiant Garden stock sharing.
records.deferredDetails: Every retail shop stock event flag, intermediate story-phase and room-spawn predicate, plus Steam binary parity.
records.deferralReason: No equipment record is left without an acquisition route. Exhaustive early-access vendor availability would support an earliest-purchase optimizer that the current journal does not offer; it is not required for the listed completion routes. The known permanent cutoff remains prominent.
records.reopenWhen: An actual listed vendor route fails in an identified story state, or an earliest-purchase planner is approved.

records.playerGoal: Meet Mushroom Journal targets and obtain challenge rewards.
records.sufficientGuidance: All twelve scored challenges have targets, rank/reward tables and strategies. The script-derived HP-floor warning and XII warp-specific Thunder protection are integrated. XIII is a reward event after the first twelve, with Look Up and Ready, Go! actions.
records.deferredDetails: Complete Mushroom AI control-flow and external initialization, XIII combat-sheet mapping, every effective phase stat and Steam byte parity.
records.deferralReason: The missing internal model does not change the supplied challenge route or reward action. XIII does not require defeating a hypothetical HP bar. A complete combat simulator or frame-perfect optimizer is beyond this acquisition guide.
records.reopenWhen: A published tactic fails because of a specific phase rule or a separately requested simulator needs exact effective values.

records.playerGoal: Find the remaining chest or sticker and complete the character collection.
records.sufficientGuidance: All 374 main chest rows and eight Secret Episode rows retain approach guidance. The 39 specifically weak chest rows have inspected locators, including paired-chest directions. The complete 60-row sticker census now has 60 useful within-room locators after correcting 26 weak notes. All 60 album placements remain separate and intact.
records.deferredDetails: Uniform save-point-to-pickup scripts, exact minimum movement and earliest access, and single-chest reward assignment where opening the documented adjacent pair suffices.
records.deferralReason: After actually correcting the 39 weak chest rows and 26 weak sticker notes, current landmarks identify the collection target. A complete repeat walkthrough adds precision without changing that action. Mere existence of 60 notes was not accepted as evidence of sufficiency.
records.reopenWhen: A named collectible remains unlocatable with its supplied landmark/approach, or a requested route needs a specific earlier or restricted movement solution.

records.playerGoal: Match a missing in-game treasure to a collectible without losing saved checks.
records.sufficientGuidance: The guide keeps 374 main chests, eight Secret Episode chests and 60 stickers separate from the tutorial, with stable character/world/room/reward identities. Source positions are explicitly not official Reports slots.
records.deferredDetails: A 374-record reconciliation against exact Steam Reports slot numbers and retail ITB report bytes.
records.deferralReason: Players can collect by location and reward without an exact Reports-slot lookup. The current feature does not promise that lookup; binary extraction would add optional indexing rather than a missing acquisition.
records.reopenWhen: An in-game Reports-slot lookup is approved or a concrete duplicate/missing chest cannot be disambiguated by current location evidence.

records.playerGoal: Reach collectibles and avoid mistakenly abandoning late cleanup.
records.sufficientGuidance: Known movement prerequisites, post-Mad-Treant return timing and HD main-save Land of Departure revisit are documented. Aqua Final Episode remains distinct. Cleanup can wait until the character has learned and leveled the indicated movement commands.
records.deferredDetails: Globally earliest visits, exact minimum movement levels and every shortcut/alternate jump.
records.deferralReason: Completion does not require collecting each item at its earliest possible moment. Higher-level movement and later main-save cleanup provide the documented route; minimum-level routing is optional optimization.
records.reopenWhen: A named collectible remains unreachable with the described commands, or a restricted/earliest-visit route is requested.

records.playerGoal: Place all stickers for 140 points and album rewards.
records.sufficientGuidance: All 60 album placement regions are integrated. Visually inspected all three completed KHRealm album images and authored the missing 28 placement landmarks, including all 20 Ventus. Placement is independent from pickup; seven-point feedback verifies the chosen spot.
records.reopenWhen: A concrete contrary observation changes the supported guidance.

records.playerGoal: Find Secret Episode’s Secret Gem in the correct area.
records.sufficientGuidance: Secret Gem is in Lower Zone: climb the raised pillars before proceeding to Upper Zone. Corrected generated instructions and retained separate Secret Episode context.
records.reopenWhen: A concrete contrary observation changes the supported guidance.

records.playerGoal: Meld Mine Square and obtain its attached ability without using the wrong recipe.
records.sufficientGuidance: Aerora Lv3 + Ignite Lv3 is an integrated working recipe with valid outcome/ability mappings. The disputed Lv1–2 eligibility is explicitly not promised.
records.deferredDetails: The lowest Ignite input level, 1 versus 3, in the retail Steam command-charge data.
records.deferralReason: Using the supported Lv3 input accomplishes the same command/ability goal. Proving that a lower-level shortcut also works would save leveling time but does not unblock the meld.
records.reopenWhen: The supported Lv3 recipe fails, or a precise minimum-level melding optimization is needed.

records.playerGoal: Meld Magnet Spiral with correct chances and abilities.
records.sufficientGuidance: Magnet Spiral 20% / Collision Magnet 80%, Stun Edge Lv3 + Magnera Lv3, all characters and crystal mappings integrated.
records.reopenWhen: A concrete contrary observation changes the supported guidance.

records.playerGoal: Find Confusion Strike consistently by its BBS name.
records.sufficientGuidance: Confusion Strike is the BBS identity; historical Confusing Strike spelling remains correction provenance only.
records.reopenWhen: A concrete contrary observation changes the supported guidance.

records.playerGoal: Know which persistent commands each HD character can obtain.
records.sufficientGuidance: Canonical persistent HD catalog now has 187 identities with independently table-backed types and character eligibility: 40 Attack, 57 Magic, 23 Item, 15 Friendship, 17 Movement, 10 Defense, 8 Reprisal, 17 Shotlock. Exclusion records distinguish temporary, multiplayer and HD-removed commands.
records.reopenWhen: A concrete contrary observation changes the supported guidance.

records.playerGoal: Obtain every persistent command needed for a build or Reports completion.
records.sufficientGuidance: All 187 persistent command identities have acquisition text. The 108 normal shops use named-world progression, 15 Medal Shop command rows state known gates, and Megalixir has chest alternatives. Three Medal Shop records still cannot explain an absent item at the stated Arena level.
records.deferredDetails: Exhaustive alternate acquisitions, 13 unspecified prior-acquisition shop alternatives, and Fire Dash conflicting price/story prose where non-shop acquisition is already supplied.
records.deferralReason: Those alternatives are optional after a usable acquisition is supplied; the three missing Medal Shop gates remain active because stock absence can block the chosen route.
records.reopenWhen: A supplied alternative fails for a named character, or an unlisted route is required; close the three active shop-gate records when applicable evidence is found.
records.openQuestion: Unison Rush and Aerial Recovery are shop-only in the inspected catalog, and their Shop Level cells remain unspecified. Voltage Stack has the same unknown purchase field but also the Element Cluster reward route. Aerial Recovery Arena 5 versus the PSP-FM required-Arena dash remains an HD first-availability question. Do not fill unknown Shop Level cells with zero or one.
records.nextEvidence: An applicable HD/FM shop table or illustrated guide giving Unison Rush, Aerial Recovery and Voltage Stack stock prerequisites, and resolving Aerial Recovery’s first availability; no binary extraction is required.

records.playerGoal: Get a desired command without relying on an unidentified enemy farm.
records.sufficientGuidance: Thirty-eight command drop records retain enemy/rate/shop-band evidence, while command acquisition and character-scoped melding offer non-drop routes. The source distinguishes world drops from acquisition guarantees.
records.deferredDetails: Every enemy-room-character drop join, reset loop and nested retail drop-table value.
records.deferralReason: Command ownership goals already have acquisition routes that do not need random world drops. An exhaustive drop atlas would optimize optional farming, rather than supply a missing command.
records.reopenWhen: A command is shown to lack a practical non-drop path, or a requested farming tool needs a specific missing encounter.

records.playerGoal: Level commands, master abilities and satisfy melding level requirements.
records.sufficientGuidance: Published maximum levels and 152 CP curves are available; conflicted/incomplete curves are flagged. Players can equip a command, gain CP until its in-game maximum, and use the displayed level for the recipe without knowing its exact remaining CP total.
records.deferredDetails: Missing retail CP rows/curves for Collision Magnet, Homing Slide, High Jump, Barrier and five Illusions, plus unresolved curve exceptions.
records.deferralReason: Exact CP scheduling is not required to master the command or check a recipe level. Do not invent numbers or treat a partial curve as a different maximum.
records.reopenWhen: A quantitative CP planner is approved, or an observed mastery/recipe boundary contradicts the current maximum.

records.playerGoal: Learn a specific permanent ability reliably.
records.sufficientGuidance: The 112 standard crystal/type relationships and character-specific recipes let players target the ability directly. No-crystal attachment chance is separate; Chaos/Secret Gem outcomes remain described as random without invented weights.
records.deferredDetails: Ability-identity probability weights and selection logic for no-crystal, Chaos Crystal and Secret Gem outcomes.
records.deferralReason: Random-ability optimization is unnecessary when the standard crystal route can produce the desired ability. Uniform distributions and expected-attempt calculators would be unsupported.
records.reopenWhen: A random-outcome probability feature is requested or an ability cannot be obtained with the current deterministic mappings.

records.playerGoal: See each ability’s effect, acquisition and enabled stack cap.
records.sufficientGuidance: All 30 ability effects, stack references and permanent-learning rules are integrated. Scan and Critical-only Zero EXP starting-command acquisition is visible even without meld recipes; modern Zero EXP CP/damage note is sourced.
records.reopenWhen: A concrete contrary observation changes the supported guidance.

records.playerGoal: Collect crystals for ability melding.
records.sufficientGuidance: Twelve route records cover all nine crystals: seven standard Twister Trench routes, early Aqueduct Abounding, three character-specific Chaos/Archraven routes and the all-character Fountain Court ordinary-Flood Secret Gem loop. Conditions give Shop bands, reset steps, Aqua main-save restriction and source limitations. All nine Medal Shop alternatives remain visible.
records.deferredDetails: Direct HD/Steam replication of the published encounter/reset syntheses; exhaustive enemy-room-character atlas, timed yields, fastest-route ranking and optimized reset timers.
records.deferralReason: Each material now has a concrete character-scoped room/enemy/drop-band/repeat route and a shop alternative. Exact replication evidence and an exhaustive or fastest atlas would strengthen provenance or optimization, but are not a missing player action. The former Chaos/Secret room gaps were researched before deferral.
records.reopenWhen: The named enemies or repeat step fail in the applicable HD room, a source establishes a changed edition condition, or a requested earlier/efficient route is unsupported.

records.playerGoal: Improve useful drop odds while farming.
records.sufficientGuidance: Lucky Strike has a five-stack cap and a labeled community formula. Enabled stacks are separate from learned copies; Prize Pod flavor hits are not modeled as ordinary prize-box rolls.
records.deferredDetails: Independent Steam proof of the exact per-stack transformation, caps/rounding and nested drop application.
records.deferralReason: Players can enable available Lucky Strike stacks without calculating an exact expected yield. The current app makes no certified time-to-drop or fastest-farm claim.
records.reopenWhen: A probability/expected-time calculator is approved, or observed behavior exposes a practical drop advice error.

records.playerGoal: Use the correct Fleeting Crystal enemy/shop-level relationship.
records.sufficientGuidance: Spiderchest Fleeting Crystal is 3.6% at Shop 1–2 only; source relationship is integrated in both generators and detail views.
records.reopenWhen: A concrete contrary observation changes the supported guidance.

records.playerGoal: Choose and collect character-appropriate Keyblades.
records.sufficientGuidance: The 24 weapon forms, 48 character/episode records, acquisition conditions, Strength/Magic values, reach evidence and Royal Radiance passive are available. Brightcrest and Master’s Defender retain episode scope.
records.deferredDetails: The Pixie Petal critical multiplier dispute (1.35 versus 1.5) and independent retail reach/stat certification.
records.deferralReason: These values do not change where the weapon is obtained or whether it completes a collection goal. Exact damage optimization is optional; the disagreement is retained rather than selected arbitrarily.
records.reopenWhen: A damage optimizer is approved, or a weapon recommendation demonstrably changes because of the disputed value.

records.playerGoal: Make ice cream, unlock Sweetstack and satisfy manufacture goals.
records.sufficientGuidance: Fourteen recipe quantities, eight eligible kinds per character, 42 flavors and 22 farming routes are integrated. Make each eligible kind once for the documented Sweetstack/Pâtissier route. Purchase only unlocks after manufacture, so bought/already-manufactured kinds need no repeat work. The three Million Dreams story awards remain distinct because avoidable ingredient farming matters.
records.deferralReason: Not deferred: whether the three story awards count can avoid unnecessary ingredient farming. Bought kinds are resolved because purchase follows prior manufacture; that does not establish story-award credit.
records.reopenWhen: Applicable HD/FM completion guidance that distinguishes story ownership from first manufacture can settle the remaining three cases.
records.openQuestion: Determine whether the Million Dreams story-awarded Rockin’ Crunch (Terra), Double Crunch (Ventus) and Royalberry (Aqua) satisfy Sweetstack manufacture completion, and distinguish Reports ownership from that reward predicate. Do not prescribe repeat manufacture for an already-made kind.
records.nextEvidence: Applicable HD/FM completion guidance that distinguishes story ownership from first manufacture can settle the remaining three cases.

records.playerGoal: Farm the required ice-cream flavors in the correct character/event.
records.sufficientGuidance: All 42 flavor records now join character-scoped room/event routes across 22 Prize Pod route records. Spawn-wave/interaction notes and world reset guidance are integrated; Arena replay reset is kept separate.
records.reopenWhen: A concrete contrary observation changes the supported guidance.

records.playerGoal: Unlock Mirage Arena battles and their rewards.
records.sufficientGuidance: Twenty-nine Arena level conditions and all six priced tickets remain integrated. A Time to Chill now gives the actual Aqua versus Terra/Ventus conditions. Legally purchased Threat/Chill tickets have explicit gates; those documented purchases already satisfy the relevant story condition.
records.deferredDetails: Hypothetical tickets obtained before their documented shop story gates; exact unrelated numeric reward values remain BBS-022.
records.deferralReason: No normal acquisition route supplies the hypothetical pre-story ticket, so that speculative state does not block using the documented ticket.
records.reopenWhen: A legal earlier ticket source is established; close the separate Combined Threat cross-clear dispute with applicable guidance.
records.openQuestion: Combined Threat: resolve the finite early-entry/other-character-clear alternative disputed by the HD Japanese guidance and KHWiki. Normal Arena 7 plus Radiant Garden and the purchased Threat Ticket path remain usable, but the potentially cheaper progression alternative should not be buried in optional precision.
records.nextEvidence: Applicable HD/FM instructions that distinguish Combined Threat’s normal Arena/world route from the other-character-clear alternative and identify which character/save condition grants entry.

records.playerGoal: Clear the correct battle to obtain its reward and Arena progress.
records.sufficientGuidance: Character reward identities, important Shotlocks/Keyblades, Mini, HP bonuses and Sky Climber are documented; the two disputed HP amounts remain visible.
records.deferredDetails: Exact modern HP increases for A Time to Chill (+5/+10) and Light’s Lessons (+10/+15).
records.deferralReason: Both disputed amounts point to the same battle and positive HP reward. Collection and Arena-clear goals do not require an exact HP budget; preserve uncertainty rather than choose a number.
records.reopenWhen: A precise HP progression planner is approved or a battle reward observation resolves the conflicting value.

records.playerGoal: Buy the correct Arena ticket at its actual documented cost/gates.
records.sufficientGuidance: Ringer Ticket costs 250 medals; Shop Level 1 AND Arena Level 5, one Dead Ringer entry. All six tickets are structured and displayed.
records.reopenWhen: A concrete contrary observation changes the supported guidance.

records.playerGoal: Understand the normalized Arena level and completion conditions.
records.sufficientGuidance: All 29 FM Arena level predicates are structured: six cumulative-medal thresholds, 15 battle clears, four five-lap course times and four board-win counts. Existing battles/races plus 30 scoped medal/board check records cover the predicates.
records.reopenWhen: A concrete contrary observation changes the supported guidance.

records.playerGoal: Earn three stars and collect each Unversed Mission reward.
records.sufficientGuidance: All nine complete rank tables and 27 character tactics are present. Conservative scoring guidance aims beyond the disputed boundary and uses the game’s awarded star rank to confirm success.
records.deferredDetails: Exact Steam equality comparators for five published score/survival thresholds.
records.deferralReason: A score above the disputed lower limit meets either interpretation. It avoids turning a one-point/one-second boundary into an unnecessary binary investigation.
records.reopenWhen: The conservative target fails, or a score-tracking feature must distinguish an exact-boundary result.

records.playerGoal: Meet minigame rewards and score/time conditions.
records.sufficientGuidance: Integrated all five Final Mix Ice Cream Beat songs with Beginner/Master Good/Cool/Fantastic scores, first/repeat prizes and controls; Fruitball opponent first/repeat rewards and tactics; all four race rewards/route guides. Original Japanese Special mode and three/nine-lap targets are explicitly excluded from HD rules.
records.reopenWhen: A concrete contrary observation changes the supported guidance.

records.playerGoal: Acquire board-exclusive commands, unlock Pete and earn Arena board wins.
records.sufficientGuidance: All seven boards, 45 bonus panels and 17 opponent inventories (288 command-level rows) are indexed. All 16 published character/mode footnotes are integrated. Use menu games for purchases, complete the game to keep them, and respect normal/limited and character eligibility. Arena win goals are separate.
records.deferredDetails: Thirty-nine unspecified Skull card multiplicities, AI purchase behavior, card draw probabilities and an exhaustive proof of all exceptions.
records.deferralReason: Players can acquire documented commands using known panel, ownership, character and menu-mode rules without knowing AI draw probabilities or exact opponent multiplicities. Missing acquisition conditions were integrated before deferring the rest.
records.reopenWhen: A named acquisition is absent in the advised mode, or an approved board simulator needs quantities/AI logic.

records.playerGoal: Unlock every branch of the finish-command tree without wasting progress.
records.sufficientGuidance: The 46 nodes identify eligible equipped parent, metric, target and style. Practical guidance now says to keep an eligible parent equipped until the desired child unlocks.
records.deferredDetails: Whether switching away and back pauses or resets partial finisher progress.
records.deferralReason: Staying on the eligible parent avoids the unknown transition entirely. A save-counter reverse-engineering project would answer an optional switching question without changing the safe unlock route.
records.reopenWhen: A player needs to recover progress after switching, or a save-inspection/progress-migration feature is approved.

records.playerGoal: Unlock and use styles, D-Links and Shotlocks, including usage achievements.
records.sufficientGuidance: Fifteen styles, thirteen persistent D-Links, seventeen Shotlocks, 39 decks/finisher lists and 22 finisher action summaries are supplied. Pete’s Rumble Rave is now usable from its explicit inputs; Reports guidance requires a nonzero hit count for each listed finisher/Shotlock, including Base and Enhanced variants.
records.deferredDetails: Pete’s exact emblem/gauge probabilities and complete finisher/Shotlock damage, duration and frame tables.
records.deferralReason: The player can activate and steer the finisher and verify a nonzero Reports hit count without these optimization numbers. Missing controls or completion actions are not deferred.
records.reopenWhen: A specific link/action cannot be performed from existing guidance, or a timing/damage simulator needs the missing values.

records.playerGoal: Defeat the optional bosses and finish the Secret Episode.
records.sufficientGuidance: Six encounter overviews give access, reward, defensive openings, healing cautions and FM/HD distinctions. Unknown now explicitly recommends Second Chance/Once More, mobile healing windows and character-specific evasions; Vanitas Remnant retains the Cure-heals-boss warning.
records.deferredDetails: Exhaustive per-character attack/recovery tables, exact frame/damage/stat fields and all challenge-run exceptions.
records.deferralReason: Ordinary completion has usable tactics and preparation without a frame-perfect strategy encyclopedia. No guarantee that a build wins every attempt is claimed.
records.reopenWhen: A concrete attack repeatedly blocks a player using the current advice, or an approved challenge-run/damage feature needs precise mechanics.

records.playerGoal: Unlock Final/Secret Episode after the main stories, especially with mixed-difficulty saves.
records.sufficientGuidance: Letter plus Reports I–XII, all three clear files, distinct Aqua episode saves and the difficulty table support ordinary progression. Keep original main clear saves; check required in-game Trinity trophies. Existing guidance does not settle failed or mixed-difficulty unlocks.
records.deferralReason: Not deferred: a wrong save-selection/aggregation rule can block story content or cause unnecessary replay. Keep this practical exception open.
records.reopenWhen: Applicable edition-aware completion/troubleshooting guidance, implementation evidence or a reproducible observation resolves the stated exception; a user playthrough is not required.
records.openQuestion: How do mixed-difficulty or problematic main clear-file combinations affect Final/Secret Episode availability, and what non-destructive action works for an affected Steam save?
records.nextEvidence: Edition-labelled successful unlock/recovery guidance explaining the clear files and difficulty combination, or authoritative selection logic. A useful guide can suffice; a complete binary/flag matrix is not required.

records.playerGoal: Earn and correctly diagnose the 45 Steam achievements.
records.sufficientGuidance: All 45 BBS API IDs/goals are mapped; no PlayStation platinum is added. Manual award checks remain distinct from item/album completion. The 2024 Steam Collector anecdote confirms a reported failure, not its cause or a safe remedy.
records.deferredDetails: Raw hidden-flag booleans and purely presentational metadata beyond the 45 named goals.
records.deferralReason: Hidden booleans do not change how the player earns a visible named goal, so that subfield is deferred. Save aggregation and current-build Collector failure diagnosis remain open because they can prevent an award.
records.reopenWhen: Applicable edition-aware completion/troubleshooting guidance, implementation evidence or a reproducible observation resolves the stated exception; a user playthrough is not required.
records.openQuestion: What non-destructive diagnosis or recovery is supported when Steam Collector remains locked despite apparently completed character collections?
records.nextEvidence: Applicable successful recovery guidance or official information that distinguishes the missing completion action from a save-aggregation failure; a single failure anecdote does not establish the cause.

records.playerGoal: Understand the edition and confidence of the guide.
records.sufficientGuidance: Sources, dates, edition distinctions and community-versus-retail provenance are explicit. Fresh page inspections are not gameplay/build certification.
records.deferredDetails: An exact executable/depot provenance stamp for otherwise usable guidance.
records.deferralReason: Binary provenance alone would not improve a known player action. It remains an evidence limitation, with targeted build checks required if a version-dependent problem appears.
records.reopenWhen: A concrete version-dependent discrepancy requires the original retail values.

records.playerGoal: Use a functioning melding reference with traceable input data.
records.sufficientGuidance: The 296-outcome source, historical workbook ranges, blank acquisition cells and repository tool lineage are preserved; current generators and solver behavior can be tested independently.
records.deferredDetails: Reconstructing an absent historical workbook/application UI or behavior.
records.deferralReason: Recovering an unavailable predecessor does not change the current player-facing recipe/ability routes. This is a provenance limitation, not an unknown game rule.
records.reopenWhen: The original artifact is supplied, or a concrete legacy behavior must be recovered.

records.playerGoal: Trust persistent progress, inventory changes and offline/mobile use.
records.sufficientGuidance: Existing implementation and tests are documented; atomic consume/undo and full mobile/offline acceptance remain engineering work. Data Jiminy stays empty.
records.deferralReason: Not deferred as game research and not marked complete: software acceptance requires its own implementation/QA work.
records.reopenWhen: The separately tracked engineering acceptance work is undertaken.

records.playerGoal: Use a faithful, readable BBS journal interface.
records.sufficientGuidance: Reference assets and prototype context exist; production art, animation/weapon integration and device fidelity remain visual/engineering acceptance.
records.deferralReason: Not converted into a gameplay research requirement or silently removed from app scope.
records.reopenWhen: The separately tracked visual/device acceptance work is undertaken.

records.playerGoal: Follow Steam HD acquisition rules without PSP or KH0.2 requirements.
records.sufficientGuidance: PSP multiplayer/transfer, standalone KH0.2 and tutorial Reports counting stay excluded. Thirteen legacy/temporary acquisition statements are now explicitly excluded from active command guidance.
records.deferralReason: Settled scope exclusions are not unanswered mechanics; broader Reports achievements retain their separate requirements.
records.reopenWhen: The user explicitly changes supported edition/game scope.

records.playerGoal: Use no-crystal attachment chances without invalid-level calculator errors.
records.sufficientGuidance: Calculator displays no-crystal ability chances 10/20/30/40/50% by combined levels, keeps Shotlocks ability-free, and rejects invalid/fractional input levels.
records.reopenWhen: A concrete contrary observation changes the supported guidance.

records.playerGoal: Collect the 438 HD treasures and their rewards.
records.sufficientGuidance: All 438 item/character/Reports identities have pickup landmarks, 51 additional source notes, and 11 Grid action improvements. Known exceptional access instructions remain on their specific entries.
deferredDetails: Exhaustive earliest-story-event, minimum-movement and returnability fields for every chest; 437 route rows lack an explicit earliest-access statement.
records.deferralReason: The current checklist supports finding each pickup, and no specific remaining inaccessible chest has been identified. An exhaustive access matrix would support a progression-gating feature that is explicitly outside the current app, rather than fix a known failed collection route.
records.reopenWhen: A player cannot reach a listed chest using its route, or a documented missable/restricted-access exception is found.

records.playerGoal: Use the sourced DDD catalog for progression and completion.
records.sufficientGuidance: All 438 legacy location rows reconciled to current HD item/area identities: 400 exact joins, 20 quantity-notation normalizations, 16 explicit replacements (14 Treasure→Candy Goggles plus La Cité Tunnels #35/#36), and two uniquely identified Curaga/Doubleflight number remaps. Existing stable IDs and HD table order retained. Explicit HD Spirit formula selection is also integrated. Resolved the known Curaga/Doubleflight order disagreement: Curaga is HD Reports2, Doubleflight3. Preserve legacy source3/2, current saved IDs and all edition replacements; remove only the outdated order caveat. This is documentary corroboration of the disputed pair, not a claim to have438 Reports screenshots.
records.deferralReason: No remaining identified research question in this already-resolved family.
records.reopenWhen: New contradictory edition-specific evidence or a concrete player issue.

records.playerGoal: Use Jestabocky’s actual board, including its B/C/D stat branch.
records.sufficientGuidance: Jestabocky’s published B-3 Left connector to A-3 is now in the canonical and generated board path. A-3 already has its ordinary A-2 approach; the B/C/D branch is reachable in the normalized source graph. No alternate Spirit is needed to explain the connector.
records.deferralReason: Resolved the actual model error by preserving an explicitly declared source path. Further binary or independent Steam-diagram proof is not required to normalize an undirected connector already in the source.
records.reopenWhen: New contradictory source evidence or an actual player report shows the published connector/board guidance is wrong.

records.playerGoal: Unlock Aura Lion’s red-secret transformation and use its existing board.
records.sufficientGuidance: The table identifies Red Secret C-7 (250 LP), Green Secret E-6 and a separate level-30 gate at D-7; the footnote disagrees. Flowbermeow remains a workaround for Faith, not closure of Aura Lion’s route.
records.deferralReason: Reopened: alternate providers help global collection, but do not settle the supported Aura Lion-specific board question.
records.reopenWhen: Close only when the stated practical question has source-backed guidance; an independent HD guide or image is sufficient and no binary proof is required.
records.openQuestion: Confirm which HD red-secret node changes Curaga C-2 to Faith, distinguishing the secret purchase from the level-30 checkpoint.
records.nextEvidence: Close only when the stated practical question has source-backed guidance; an independent HD guide or image is sufficient and no binary proof is required.

records.playerGoal: Create the HD-only Spirits and unlock their useful disposition branches.
records.sufficientGuidance: Recipes, costs, board rewards and known interactions are present. Five missing direct transitions now have explicit two-step alternatives through known cells. A sourced treat-color route also avoids petting precision.
deferredDetails: 15 base-stat values for Beatalike/Catanuki/Tubguin Ace and five direct-interaction body-part cells.
records.deferralReason: Base-stat comparison is an optimization issue, not a prerequisite to creation or board rewards. The five missing interactions are not unreachable dispositions: all can be reached through sourced alternatives. Unknown cells remain unknown.
records.reopenWhen: A stat calculator is approved, an actual combat choice depends on missing values, or a documented interaction detour fails.

records.playerGoal: Create the intended Spirit using the selected recipe mode, including colliding custom ingredient combinations.
records.sufficientGuidance: The HD menu guide distinguishes an owned Recipes tab from custom creation. Runtime now says to obtain/select the named recipe for its documented recipe route and to inspect custom preview odds. Two double-marked pairs and a third marked/unmarked collision are recorded explicitly; unconditional raw-input 100% text was removed.
deferredDetails: Probabilities of unrelated unmarked alternatives beyond the three colliding creation events; exact expected-cost optimization.
records.deferralReason: Reopened: contradictory 100% raw-input guidance could spend a player’s ingredients on the wrong intended breed. A recipe-backed fallback is useful, but does not verify the displayed custom formulas.
records.reopenWhen: Close only when the stated practical question has source-backed guidance; an independent HD guide or image is sufficient and no binary proof is required.
records.openQuestion: Determine HD custom-creation selection/outcome semantics for Noble Fancy×3 + Grim Figment×4 (Cyber Yog/Sir Kyroo), Epic Fantasy×1 + Intrepid Fantasy×3 (Tyranto Rex/Ursa Circus), and Rampant Figment×4 + Vibrant Fancy×3 (Jestabocky/Meow Wow).
records.nextEvidence: Close only when the stated practical question has source-backed guidance; an independent HD guide or image is sufficient and no binary proof is required.

records.playerGoal: Create useful ranks, earn Golden Egg and train Spirits for board level gates.
records.sufficientGuidance: Material rank thresholds, the weaker-ingredient rule and donation bonuses are documented.
